objective: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

description: The undead fear life just as the living fear death. It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.
Unfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.
You must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. May luck be with you, <name>.
progress: A keepsake of remembrance is a rare find, <name>.
completion: I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.
Prepare yourself, <name>, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.
